data.overview: A humble shepherd with a gift for song is drawn into a struggle for the future of his people when a towering champion challenges their army. Armed with little more than a sling and unshakable faith, he must survive the fight and the dangerous politics that follow.
data.tagline: Courage can change the course of a kingdom.
data.title: The Shepherd’s Promise
